ACTION MEMO
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MARCH 18, 2014

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  March 18, 2014
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Present: Vandever, Chang, King, Thomas & Evans
  Absent: None

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC – None

CONSENT ITEMS – #8 & 9

1.  M-956-14; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for a structure exceeding the
  allowable height at the single family residence located at 3932 Via Valmonte. Lot 5,
  Block 6222, Tract 6887. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner:  Patricia Hourigan

Continued to the April 15, 2014 Planning Commission meeting.

OLD BUSINESS

2.  NC-1478/GA-1513-13; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading
  Applications for a new single family residence located at 1320 Via Romero. Lot 1, Block
  2329, Tract 6890. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant:  Luis DeMoraes
  Envirotechno Architecture
  13101 Washington Blvd., #404
  Los Angeles, CA 90066
  Owner:  Fias Homes, LLC
  314 Tejon Pl.
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Planning Commission  1  Director  SR-L
Action Memo
March 18, 2014
 Action: Commissioner King moved and Commissioner Thomas seconded to approve the
application (5-0) with standard conditions and following additional conditions 1) A licensed
survey of the floor area is to be completed and submitted to the City to verify compliance
with the approved floor area; 2) A standard urban stormwater mitigation plan, approved
by the City Engineer shall be prepared and implemented for the project; 3) Pull eaves out
of side setbacks.

Action: Commissioner King moved and Commissioner Evans seconded to approve the

Remove the BBQ and fire pit from the setbacks.
